ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-05-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of THREE Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioners: Yoshabel Clements and John G. Hanlin, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Gavin Galahad Clements, Chayton Marlon Clements and Alcon Keele CLements, were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Gavin Galahad Hanlin, Chayton Marlon Hanlin and Alcon Keele Hanlin.
Decree signed in open court.
